svg.title: OmniAnchor: scored event, named coordinates, and two validation routes
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the user-provided figure. All text, formula components, tables, connectors, icons and scatter points are vector objects. Two editable image objects show the documented OASIS I466 Lake 12 photograph. Scores and scatter points remain conceptual, not empirical measurements.
